subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split and retire this umbrella now, keep it open as a broad production field-report tracker, or close it after linking the active config and missed-message trackers?
rationale: The report spans config recovery, Discord delivery, cron docs/CLI, onboarding auth, web search, resource policy, and update process behavior; code evidence supports partial fixes and multiple active canonical trackers, but not one deterministic close or one safe automatic fix PR.

options.title: Split And Retire Umbrella
options.body: Move unresolved slices to owner-scoped canonical issues, keep the config and missed-message work on the existing trackers, and close this issue once every slice has a durable home.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as a broad field-report tracker until maintainers explicitly accept, reject, or split every remaining slice.

options.title: Close After Linking Canonicals
options.body: Close this issue now as mostly superseded by the active config and missed-message trackers, accepting that weaker slices may need new reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split And Retire Umbrella
recommendation.body: Move unresolved slices to owner-scoped canonical issues, keep the config and missed-message work on the existing trackers, and close this issue once every slice has a durable home.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is cross-surface product triage across config recovery, channel delivery, CLI/setup, and docs, and steipete has the strongest sampled history across those areas.
